survivors.title: Swage for jewelry workshops
survivors.pitch: For jewelry workshops, unsearchable job cards. The machine plate unlocks the exact manual page: piece tracking ready in minutes, prints compliance badges on the spot.

survivors.title: Pintle Bench
survivors.pitch: Point a phone, get commissioning reports: site photos become daily logs with warnings for solar crews, prints compliance badges on the spot.

verdicts.attack: Job cards in jewelry are already digitized; this solves a non-existent problem
verdicts.why: Unique solution to a niche, underserved problem with clear workflow integration

verdicts.attack: Tour agencies already have inventory systems; this is a solution looking for a problem
verdicts.why: Doesn't solve a real pain point beyond existing inventory management

verdicts.attack: Solar compliance is highly regulated; automated reports may not meet certification requirements
verdicts.why: Strong visual recognition workflow with clear time/money savings for a specific industry

verdicts.attack: Visual task verification is already done by quality control systems; redundant solution
verdicts.why: Generic concept with no unique value proposition beyond existing factory systems

verdicts.attack: Container yards already have digital logs; adding voice doesn't solve core problems
verdicts.why: Doesn't address fundamental inefficiencies in container yard operations

verdicts.attack: HVAC maintenance logs are already digitized; voice input doesn't solve the core problem
verdicts.why: Doesn't address why crews don't log maintenance promptly, just changes input method
